reserveReview.rationale: The KPMG-examined USDP Redemption Assets Report as of May 29, 2026 reports $24,823,770 of cash and $7,149,000 of repurchase agreements, for total redemption assets of $31,972,770. The report states that the repos mature overnight, are overcollateralized by U.S. Treasury obligations, and may not be sold or repledged. The two reported asset types normalize to 77.64% and 22.36%.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: KPMG examination of the USDP Redemption Assets Report as of May 29, 2026
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The report identifies the complete asset-type composition. Individual commercial-bank and broker-dealer counterparties are anonymized, but no reserve asset class is unclassified.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The report establishes segregated, unencumbered redemption assets held for USDP token holders and prohibits selling or repledging the securities collateralizing the repo agreements. It does not identify every bank or repo counterparty or establish rehypothecation terms for cash deposits.
